verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a bare 'Web Scraping & Search' feature label, MCP compatibility, and a custom agent skill developer guide. None of these documents the assistant itself driving a real browser to navigate, log in, click and extract from live pages. Scraping is an adjacent capability, and MCP or custom skills are building blocks a user would have to wire up themselves, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can drive a real browser — navigate, log in, click, and extract from live pages on my behalf
